bagPolicy.summary: For Gators football, Ben Hill Griffin Stadium uses the SEC clear bag policy: one clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bag up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches or a one-gallon clear resealable bag, plus a small clutch up to 4.5 x 6.5 inches. Concert rules can be stricter. For Morgan Wallen's May 2026 shows, only wallets, wristlets and clutch or crossbody bags up to 4.5 x 6.5 inches were allowed, and larger bags were not allowed even if clear.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bag no larger than 12 x 6 x 12 inches
One-gallon clear resealable plastic storage bag
Small clutch no larger than 4.5 x 6.5 inches, with or without a handle or strap
Diapers carried in a clear bag
prohibited: Coolers or containers, including cans and cups
Any bag larger than the permitted size
bagPolicy.note: Clear bags must be clear from top to bottom; a trim of up to 2 inches and one logo up to 4.5 x 3.4 inches are allowed. Fans with medical items use the Bag entry line for inspection.

parking.note: Parking near the stadium is limited and sold in advance by zone. For Morgan Wallen's May 2026 concerts, the Orange Zone (North Lawn, Lots 18, 20, 25, 26) was $125, the Blue Zone (Flavet Field, Lots 29, 30, 36, 38, 57, 112) was $75, and the Yellow Zone (Garages 113 and 114, Lot 114A) was $50, first come, first served. On football game days, the university points fans to shuttles because public lots are limited.
parking.summary: Parking is limited and sold in advance by zone for concerts.

rideshare.note: Florida Athletics doesn't post a rideshare drop-off or pickup zone for the stadium. On football game days, shuttle tickets can be bought ahead or on game day by card in the GoRTS Fares Transit app, and Park and Ride locations sell day-of tickets for cash only.
rideshare.summary: No official rideshare zone is posted.

concessions.note: Food and drink sales at Ben Hill Griffin Stadium are fully cashless; stands take credit cards, debit cards and touchless phone payment. You can turn cash into a gift card at any Grab N' Go location.
concessions.summary: All food and drink sales are cashless.
stands: Grab N Go Gators (inside Gate 18 and North End Zone main concourse)

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The stadium has two accessible elevators reserved for guests with disabilities and mobility needs, and accessible restrooms throughout. Fans who need a wheelchair space or accessible seating should contact the Gator Ticket Office before event day at 800-34-GATOR (352-375-4683 ext. 6800), TDD/TTY 711. Family restrooms are on the west side inside the Gate 2 corridor. Only service dogs are allowed; emotional support animals do not qualify.
accessibility.summary: Two accessible elevators are available, and accessible seating is arranged through the Gator Ticket Office.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Once your ticket has been scanned, you can't leave and re-enter Ben Hill Griffin Stadium. This applied to football games and to Morgan Wallen's May 2026 concerts.
reEntry.summary: There is no re-entry once your ticket is scanned.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: On event days, will call and the ticket office are outside Gate 1 of Exactech Arena at the Stephen C. O'Connell Center and open three hours before the event. On non-event days, the Gator Ticket Office is at Gate 2 on the west side of the stadium.
ticketPickup.summary: Will call is outside Gate 1 of Exactech Arena and opens three hours before the event.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: For football, gates open 90 minutes before kickoff and students enter through Gate 9 or Gates 12 to 15. For Morgan Wallen's May 2026 concerts, all gates opened at 4:30 p.m., Field Level ticket holders entered by the SEZ Ramp between Gates 15 and 16, and Express Entry lanes were at Gates 1, 4, 7, 8, 12, 16, the SEZ Ramp and West Premium. Guest Services kiosks are at Gates 2, 7 and 16.
gates.summary: Football gates open 90 minutes before kickoff; concert gate times are set per show.
